english: Come, O Lord, and show Thy face to us, Thou that sittest upon the cherubim: and we shall be saved.
Come, O Lord, and show Thy face to us, Thou that sittest upon the cherubim: and we shall be saved.
A light shall shine upon us this day: for Our Lord is born to us; and He shall be called wonderful, God, the prince of peace, the Father of the world to come; of Whose reign there shall be no end.
While all things were in quiet silence, and the night was in the midst of her course, Thy almighty word, O Lord, came from heaven, from Thy royal throne.
A child is born to us, and a Son is given to us; Whose government is upon His shoulder; and His name shall be called the angel of great counsel.
